# FleetMores — Promoting TruckBill Transport ERP
> FleetMores is promoting TruckBill, India's premier transport operations and billing ERP for fleet owners, transport contractors, and freight brokers.

## Company & Product Summary
- **Organization**: FleetMores Technologies Pvt Ltd
- **Product Name**: TruckBill
- **Product Type**: Cloud-based Transport ERP & Logistics SaaS
- **Primary Function**: Automates digital LR (Lorry Receipt / Bilty) generation, trip dispatch, market lorry settlements, driver advances, diesel audit, customer GST billing, and Section 194C TDS compliance.
- **Geographic Coverage**: Pan-India (Delhi-NCR, Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune, Indore, Ludhiana, Jaipur, Hyderabad).
- **Official Website**: https://fleetmores.com/
- **Support & Sales Line**: +91 8000 553 311
- **Email**: contact@fleetmores.com

## 12 Specialized Engines of TruckBill
1. **Digital LR & Bilty Engine**: Auto-sequenced LRs matching pre-printed stationery, multi-item details, GST tax rates, and instant WhatsApp PDF sharing.
2. **Trip Dispatch & Vehicle Allocation**: Assign own fleet, attached trucks, or market broker vehicles with verified loading slips.
3. **Market Vehicle & Broker Settlement**: Calculate lorry hire rate vs party freight rate, diesel slip advances, cash deductions, and broker commission.
4. **Customer Invoicing & TDS Management**: Single or monthly multi-LR tax invoices with detention charges and Section 194C TDS (1% or 2%) calculation.
5. **Diesel & FASTag Audit**: Pump slip reconciliation, toll debits, route mileage audit, and en-route cash vouchers.
6. **Mobile POD Capture**: Driver smartphone photo upload of stamped Proof of Delivery to unblock customer payment submission.
7. **Transport Accounting & Khata**: Double-entry party ledgers, broker khata, driver passbook, and cash books tailored to Indian transport customs.
8. **Vehicle-Wise Net Profit & Loss**: Track revenue, fuel costs, driver wages, maintenance, and EMI per truck every month.
9. **Driver Trip Passbook**: Driver trip allowances, route advances, and proof of delivery tracking to prevent disputes.
10. **Permit, Fitness & Insurance Alerts**: Proactive automated expiry alerts for commercial vehicle documents.
11. **Multi-Branch Hierarchy**: Centralized head office visibility over booking branches and delivery hubs across India.
12. **WhatsApp Business Intelligence**: Automated delivery of LRs, tracking links, POD copies, and invoice payment reminders.

## Target Segments
- **Transport Contractors & Agencies**: Corporate contract rates, multi-LR monthly invoicing, detention billing.
- **Fleet Owners (Own Trucks)**: Vehicle P&L, diesel mileage audit, driver advances, document expiries.
- **Commission Agents & Freight Brokers**: Dual-rate lorry vouchers, commission margin locks, supplier TDS compliance.

## Indian Compliance & Localization
- **GST Compliance**: Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM) & Forward Charge Mechanism (FCM) support.
- **Income Tax**: Automated Section 194C TDS deduction & Pan-10 truck declaration recordkeeping.
- **E-Way Bill**: E-Way bill number tracking and portal compatibility.
- **FASTag & Fuel**: Direct toll and pump slip reconciliation.
